summary: Heavy sumo on a gate that actually works, and the first real change to the bench's stimulus in four blocks: a second comp-bench exposure at six reps. Squat drops to a fixed moderate band so the axial budget goes to the pull. Pull-up held back by an absolute-load cap for the elbow and for Friday.

1.label: BUILD
1.description: NOT a calibration week - FB 2026-10-12 ruled no warm-up week after a deload. Sumo opens at the 345 band floor. Bench 255 work up to @7.5.

2.label: ESTABLISH
2.description: Sumo 365 (gated). Bench 265 work up to @8. Dip builds to BW+90.

3.label: PUSH
3.description: Sumo 385 (gated). DIP PEAK - work up to @8, lid BW+115. Spoto holds at 255 because the dip peaks the same day.

4.label: PEAK
4.description: Sumo 405 - the hard ceiling, gated. BENCH PEAK - floor 280, lid 295. Dip HOLDS so it never peaks the same week as the bench.

5.label: DELOAD
5.description: Everything down. Fixed loads, @6, do not chase. Nothing made up at home.

exercises.name: Comp Bench
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - BENCH GOES FIRST on D1 this block. It is the priority lift and the squat is moderate, so the heavy lift gets the fresh body. Work up to @7.5 and STOP: floor 255, lid 265 - take the heaviest set at or under @7.5. Going above the floor is not creep; going above the lid is. Backoffs 4x4 @ 210. Shoulder: <=3/10 pain on every rep, always. Arch and upper back stay set - losing the arch under fatigue is the weak point this block is built around.

exercises.name: Low-bar Squat
exercises.hold_reason: Squat is the MODERATE axial lift this block (alternating-axial-emphasis): a fixed band that tops at 395, well under B6's 435 peak, so the axial budget goes to heavy sumo. Written below the log on purpose; the sync must not rebase it.
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - MODERATE, FIXED. 365x3 x3, @7 ceiling. This is not a floor and there is no range: do not autoregulate upward. B6's sumo was written exactly this way and climbed +30 lb on feel - that is the mistake this wording exists to stop. You squatted 435x3 @7.5 three weeks ago, so 365 will feel easy. That is the point: sumo is taking the axial load this block and the squat is holding its groove.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Chest Fly - alternate sets, ~30 s between. Lockout (bench weak point) -> triceps. Stop at @8. Alt: Cable Triceps Extension, same load.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Tricep Pushdown. Pec isolation without a fifth press. STOP the handles before the elbows travel behind the torso - the stretched bottom loads the anterior capsule where the subscapularis tear sits. Alt: Seated Cable Fly 70.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
exercises.notes: Per arm, one at a time. Monday's pull dose (whole-body-every-day), chest-supported, zero lumbar load. Held under the 135 median so it does not pre-fatigue Tuesday's pull-up. FIRST CUT on D1 if the morning runs out or Tuesday's backoffs suffer. Alt: CS Incline Row (DB) 45/hand. Never T-bar or bent-over.
exercises.hold_reason: Deliberately under the 135 log median: D1 row must not pre-fatigue D2 weighted pull-up, which is already elbow-limited this block.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Anti-lateral-flexion. 30-45 s per side.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-up
exercises.hold_reason: Capped by ABSOLUTE load for two independent reasons: BOTH elbows (anterior, pain on flexion; left since ~late Sept 2026, right from late Oct) and heavy sumo on D4 (CLAUDE.md - pull-up volume drops when deadlift volume is high). Tops at BW+85, under B6's BW+95 and B5's BW+90, on purpose. The sync must not rebase it.
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - FIXED LOAD BW+55x4, no range, no 'work up to'. Backoffs BW+35x5 x3. ELBOWS (both, anterior - left since ~late Sept, right from late Oct): GRIP WIDER THAN SHOULDER WIDTH, PRONATED. NOT neutral - your own 10-22 note says the neutral grip is what hurt the right inner elbow. Wide felt slightly weaker to you and that is the right trade. Any pain DURING a set ends the exercise for the day - don't finish the set. Report it the same day. Fixed load, not an RPE target: a sore tendon can't be autoregulated. Why it is lower than B6: the elbow is live AND this is the heavy-sumo block, so the back/lat/grip budget goes to Friday. Chin over the bar every rep or the set is over.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.notes: NEW THIS BLOCK (last trained Nov 2023). SUPERSET with Hip Thrust. Straight arms - ZERO elbow flexion, which is the whole point: it is the lat stimulus the elbow currently forbids everywhere else. Also loads serratus, which helps scapular upward rotation and the subacromial space. Soft elbows, move at the shoulder only. Opens well under the stale 61 lb anchor. Alt: Rope Straight Arm Pulldown.
exercises.hold_reason: 3-year-gap re-entry: 28 sessions but all 2022-2023, median 61 lb. Per secondary-first-exposure a stale anchor is history, not a starting point - open under it and let the log re-establish the level.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Straight Arm Pulldown. Sumo lockout / out of the hole -> glutes. This is the hitch work: the deadlift secondary pool is entirely blocked medical, so the glutes get trained here instead. Tuesday, three days clear of Friday's pull. Alt: Glute Bridge (Barbell) 185.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Lateral Raise. Hamstrings, knee-flexion side. Alt: Lying Leg Curl.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Seated Leg Curl. Lateral delts. FIRST CUT on D2 if the morning runs out. Alt: Cable Lateral Raise 20.

exercises.name: Single Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
exercises.notes: Per arm. Front delts on a diagonal path - less subacromial compression than any overhead press. @7 CAP, and that cap is the shoulder's, not a preference: two low-grade partial tears plus bursitis. Load is plates on the sleeve, not counting the bar. Alt: Neutral-grip DB Press (seated) 45, same @7 cap. NEVER barbell OHP.
exercises.hold_reason: Shoulder slot under a hard @7 cap (two partial-thickness tears + subacromial bursitis). The cap, not the log, sets this load.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Anti-rotation. Slow, no hip rotation.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - BW+80x5 @7, backoffs BW+65x5 x3. DEPTH BEFORE LOAD - stop above the pinch every rep; the AC joint and the bursa are what the bottom position compresses. Dip peaks W3 and HOLDS in W4 so it never peaks the same week as the bench (CLAUDE.md overlap rule).

exercises.name: Spoto Bench Press
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - 250x3 x3, @7.5 ceiling. HELD, not rotated: it has progressed every single session for two blocks and it is the only bench movement with an unbroken upward record. Pause an inch off the chest, dead stop, then drive - it trains the sticking point.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Leg Extension. Lats, seated, no axial load. HELD WELL UNDER the 157 median this block - tomorrow is a 345-405 sumo and the lats hold the bar. Alt: Natural Grip Pulldown, same load. ELBOW: wide pronated grip here too - the 10-22 'right inner elbow pain with the neutral grip' note was on THIS exercise. No neutral bar.
exercises.hold_reason: Held under the 157 log median on purpose: D3 lat work must not pre-fatigue D4, which is HEAVY sumo this block. This is a sumo-protection pin, not a progression target.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Lat Pulldown. Thursday's lower-body dose (whole-body-every-day) and the lowest-cost option that exists before a heavy Friday pull: no spinal load, no loaded hip flexion, no adductor cost. Alt: Leg Press 270, ROM-capped. NO squat pattern, NO hinge, NO adductor work on D3 this block.
exercises.hold_reason: Flat at/under the 135-140 median: D3 quad work must not pre-fatigue D4 heavy sumo.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Face Pull. @7 CAP - shoulder slot. Load-bearing work: the intact posterior cuff shares load off two torn anterior tendons. Alt: Rear Delt Fly (DB) 25.
exercises.hold_reason: Shoulder slot under a hard @7 cap. Ran to @9.5 in B5 under this same cap; the cap sets the load, not the log.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Reverse Pec Deck. External rotation + scapular control. @7. FIRST CUT on D3 if the morning runs out (same target family as the pec deck). Alt: Band pull-apart x20.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Anti-extension. Ribs down, low back flat to the floor.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.hold_reason: HEAVY sumo under sumo-back-cap (band 345-405, @7 cap, reps <=4, 405 hard ceiling) AND still on axial-return-ladder: every rung is an absolute load gated on the next-morning back check. Never rebase this from the log.
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - SUMO IS THE BLOCK. 345x3, backoffs 305x3 x3. sumo-back-cap: @7 is a HARD cap, reps <=4, every rep crisp, 405 is the hard ceiling. Any back rounding or bar-speed drop -> rack it. NEVER grind sumo. GATE: this rung is unlocked only by Saturday's back check on last week's pull reading `fine`. `tight` -> repeat last week's load. No check logged -> repeat last week's load. Two `sore` in a row -> axial work stops, back to the clinic. Sumo goes FIRST on D4, always. Tall lockout, no hitch - if it hitches above the knee the weight is too heavy for today regardless of what the plan says.

exercises.name: Comp Bench
exercises.notes: W1 BUILD - SECOND COMP-BENCH EXPOSURE, and the whole reason this block exists for your bench. 210x6 x4, FIXED, @7 ceiling. This is not a second heavy day - do not chase it. Sixes, because 'loses arch under fatigue' is your bench weak point and a double never exposes it. Hold the arch and the upper back on rep 6 exactly as on rep 1; if the arch collapses, the set is over even if the reps are there. Shoulder <=3/10. Bench goes AFTER sumo today.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with CS Incline Row. Calves. FIRST CUT on D4 if the morning runs out. NO standing or barbell calf raise as a fallback - axial compression, and the back is under treatment.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Incline Row
exercises.notes: SUPERSET with Seated Calf Raise. Mid-back, chest-supported, zero lumbar load - which is why it is the row that survives on a heavy-pull day. Alt: Seated Cable Row 120. NEVER barbell bent-over.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
exercises.notes: ADDED THIS BLOCK, and it is sumo-specific: adductors are a sumo-stance muscle and this is the heavy-sumo block. Takes the slot the Concentration Curl vacated (direct elbow flexion is out while the right elbow is sore). AFTER sumo, never before. Anchor is your real 105-115, not the 90s.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.notes: Spine-neutral endurance. Slow, no lumbar rotation. Per side.
